title: (Pwn2Own) Synology BeeStation Plus auth_info Stack-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Synology BeeStation Plus. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of the auth_info parameter. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.
